newsitem.title: USA: MLC sells stock to Hitachi Leasing unit.
newsitem.headline: MLC sells stock to Hitachi Leasing unit.

text.p: MLC Holdings Inc said Wednesday it had closed a private placement of $2 million of stock with WIHL-IV (Cayman) Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Hitachi Leasing (Singapore) Pte Ltd.

MLC said its business with Hitachi Leasing America, a sister company of Hitachi Leasing (Singapore), has been limited to non-recourse debt financing, and it is exploring ways to expand the volume and type of business it can finance with them.
MLC is a diversified leasing and asset management company specializing in information technology equipment for commercial, government, and vendor customers.
Hitachi Leasing (Singapore) is a unit of Hitachi Leasing Ltd (Tokyo).
